description: High-Resolution Dynamic Material Flow Analysis to Elucidate Plastic Flows in Waste Management Systems is published by Zhang, Yiwen; Wang, Zhanyun; Oguchi, Masahiro; Yamamoto, Haruhisa; Nowack, Bernd. The package contains dynamic material-flow databases for plastic in waste-management systems. Its stated coverage is Japan; base series from 1990 to 2023, with an extended construction-sector model. Further dates and resolution are unknown unless specified by the provider. The provider exposes machine-readable metadata and lists SQLite resources; data files were not downloaded. The inspected public resource is free to access. The licence is cc-by-4.0. Modelled flows are not direct observations; sector-specific time spans differ. For simulation, it can inform waste-service capacity planning or comparisons of collection and treatment scenarios; this is a reviewer assessment of potential use. Related record model-swolfpy provides a comparison in the same service area; technical compatibility was not tested.
